assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient is accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
The transient cerebral ischemic attack is coded as ICD-10 G45.9
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded as CPT 93229
The purpose of the mobile cardiac telemetry is to correlate intermittent arrhythmic events with clinical symptoms and assess for potential embolic sources or hemodynamic instability
The payer's denial is identified as PR-204
The denial states that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The ordered procedure directly addresses the intermittent arrhythmic events and transient cerebral ischemic attack indicated for this patient
